description: Blocks `git reset --hard` and `git clean` with a real `-f`/`--force` flag (alone or clustered with `-d`/`-x`) — both irreversibly wipe uncommitted/untracked work with no undo. Allows `git checkout -- <file>`/`git restore <file>`, bare/`--mixed`/`--soft` reset, and `git clean -n`/no-force. Deny-by-default: no env-var/inline self-service bypass (removed, Alex tg#6554); a repo owner may wire agent_hooks.approval_cmd in rig.yaml for external approval, else the block stands. NOTE: this hook is ALWAYS ON (no opt-in), so with nothing configured reset --hard/clean -f becomes a hard repo-wide block. Every dangerous segment in a CHAINED command is gated (approving one never waves a later one through), so a single invocation can call approval_cmd more than once; an internal 10s AGGREGATE budget across the whole chain (see block_reset_hard._MAIN_LOOP_BUDGET_S) denies with a clear message once that budget is spent, rather than let a legitimately-approved multi-segment command run long enough to hit this descriptor's timeout_ms 12000. on_error=closed: if the check itself fails, deny rather than let a destructive reset/clean through.
